name: zreader_read_named_string
description: zReader::ReadNamedString resolves direct string nodes and array-wrapped string nodes by name.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 byte verification for 0x48cf80 through the shared zreader_get_named_node target passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48cf80 calls zReader_GetNamedNode, returns null when the named node is missing, returns the direct string node value for type 3, and for type 4 arrays returns the first payload child value only when that child is a string.
The native smoke validates direct string lookup, array-wrapped string lookup, and missing string lookup through the accepted named-node dependency.
